release_dependency: M5 evaluator qualification and freeze accepted

sample.unit: one unique (suite,case_id) per panel; choose first sealed primary trial in the selected stratum via ascending SHA256(seed || canonical identifier)
sample.population: complete unique physical primary roster with public task, observed behavior and assessable material; publish per-stratum eligibility losses

representative.allocation: Use largest-remainder proportional allocation to nonempty strata; reserve one seat per stratum when feasible. Use inclusion weights for population estimates. Record undercoverage.

challenge.allocation: After representative draw, remove overlaps and legacy 22 cases. Assign each remaining case to its first eligible listed bucket. Round-robin one case per nonempty bucket until 80 or exhaustion. Ascending keyed hash within buckets.

sample.legacy: Score and report separately. Preserve 22 historical cases. Exclude from expansion draws.
sample.extension: Before unblinding, if representative margin exceeds 8 percentage points at 95% in preregistered worst-case design, add representative cases using same rule up to 300 total representative cases; preserve original inclusion probabilities.

blinding.dispatch: Use opaque shuffled IDs in one mixed presentation. Custodian keeps the draw manifest, AI records and keys separately; a reviewer with prior label access is ineligible.

submission.reviewers: Two independent reviewers. Add a third for high-risk items or unresolved disagreements.
submission.freeze: Custodian hash-locks both independent initial submissions before any reconciliation. Record disagreements, third opinions and final decision as separate records.

completion: Require real reviewer submissions. Record missing reviews as NOT_RUN; release no AI labels to reviewers during independent scoring.
